evaluator: Independent fictionalized Warren Sack analytical lens; not Warren Sack, no endorsement
evidence: home.png and home.html place About in the primary navigation, making the binding method statement reachable in one click. The homepage also frames the social-system connection plainly: the system lives between the screen and the room, joining invitations, meetings, source maps, public action paths, digital surfaces, and handoffs.

about.html explicitly states the recursive sequence: observe relationships, model a system, prototype an interface, test it with people, and document enough for others to continue. Its Three systems loops section links directly to Harry J. Epstein Company, NYC Artist Coalition/FairRentNYC, and Sunday Dinner/196 evidence pages.

hje.html reconstructs the sequence through customer and team friction, a joined customer/team operating model, incremental storefront and workflow changes, inspection of public paths and signals, and reusable patterns with assigned next actions. Its artifact gallery includes a storefront image and a maintenance-to-handoff specimen.

fair-rent.html traces lived experience, meetings, public sources, and policy actors into a recoverable civic model; campaign sites, working sessions, town halls, hearings, and action paths then support collective use; running minutes, source maps, question logs, and action trackers provide learning and continuity. Approved screenshots, public links, source notes, and explicit collective-credit limits make the proof inspectable.

sunday-dinner.html turns hospitality, trust, artist support, invitations, access, documentation, and follow-up into repeatable participation infrastructure. Its two public-safe handoff specimens show use, documentation, continuation, and privacy-preserving transfer without exposing participant-level records.

wowlist.html independently reinforces the pattern: organizers' existing community language becomes a natural-language keyword model, then calendars, profiles, digests, and embeds used by organizers across a dated 35-city snapshot. Public support material, an independent tutorial, adoption examples, credits, and relaunch limits document learning and stewardship.

callnyc.html shows administrative data observed as a resident-navigation problem, modeled as issue and district pathways, implemented as a public interface, exercised through public release and documented interactions, and preserved through a public repository, reporting, source notes, and an explicit archived handoff.

team-memory.html connects knowledge already present in people, language, artifacts, and relationships to a three-graph model, a bounded prototype interface, teammate testing, correction paths, and a continue/revise/stop handoff. It labels the work early research and a proposed engagement rather than client adoption or production deployment.

The coursework-versus-current-proof audit is clean: about.html labels historical systems as lineage, rejects structural equivalence and present-proficiency inference, and disclaims peer-reviewed research and production deployment. public-resume.pdf places AI Evals under professional development and labels technical experience current and historical. open-house-public-article.html dates the social-software course reference to its 2006 article context without claiming present proficiency or endorsement.
safety_findings: The inspected candidate makes no claim of Warren Sack's participation, opinion, endorsement, or authority.

No inspected page or the public resume claims disciplinary invention, peer-reviewed research, sole authorship, current Max/Jitter proficiency, or a completed Knowledge Wiki Graph production deployment.
about.html expressly says the recurring steps are an analytical pattern, not proof that different projects are structurally equivalent, and preserves missing relationships as missing.

fair-rent.html, wowlist.html, and sunday-dinner.html preserve collective credit and withhold private notes, participant data, contact lists, legal-review material, credentials, and unapproved records.

team-memory.html separates access, evidence, consent, publication permission, and human authority; its example is explicitly synthetic and its proposed pilot is not represented as completed client work.
callnyc.html repeatedly identifies the interface as archived, independent, unofficial, and unsuitable for current constituent-service guidance.
